_comment: Focused REAL-phone battery for the self-improvement run (German Pixel). Read/nav + benign tasks only — NO display-mutating (brightness/font/display-size) so we don't change the user's real settings, and NO send/pay/delete. Mix of tasks that succeed cold (mine -> replay) and ones that fail cold (should improve as demos/replay accumulate over rounds).

tasks.name: gtv_kids_movie
tasks.query: find a movie suitable for a 6 year old and open its detail page

tasks.name: gmail_latest
tasks.query: open and read the latest email

tasks.name: calendar_week
tasks.query: show what is on my calendar this week

tasks.name: weather_weekend
tasks.query: check the weather for this weekend

tasks.name: keep_note
tasks.query: create a note that says buy milk

tasks.name: maps_pharmacy
tasks.query: find a pharmacy nearby in maps and open the nearest one

tasks.name: youtube_yoga
tasks.query: find a 10 minute yoga video on youtube and play it

tasks.name: chrome_wikipedia
tasks.query: open chrome and go to wikipedia.org
